comment: ugh another price bump on top of the UI mess. the recommendations are still the only reason i'm here, but i'm not paying more for an app that buries my library and shoves AI DJ at me. YouTube Music is already a great deal, so i'm really thinking about it.

$1 more a month for the same thing, and the heart button is still gone. this is nickel and dime stuff. if they keep charging for features that used to be standard i'm going to stop pretending it's fine.

a month still costs less than an hour of my pay and no ads is worth it to me. the annoying part is the renewal flow, because i never know if i'm on trial or what. the price bump itself doesn't bother me much.

$5.99 for student is still good, but that's the number going up and i'm a broke student. they already dropped Showtime from the bundle so i'm not thrilled. if the Hulu part goes too i'm looking at other options.
eleven bucks is still bang for the buck. i use it every day in the car and the no ads thing is worth every penny. ads are creeping up on the free side though, which is annoying but not a dealbreaker.
worth every penny for me, the spotlight stuff alone pays for it. a couple bucks more is annoying but i'm not dropping it. still hoping they bring back the features they removed though.

i'm on free so this doesn't hit me directly, but $11 for premium is a harder sell when the free version already works for playlists. the ads are still the thing that would push me to pay. not sure i'd ever go up.

already cancelled over the redesign so the price doesn't even matter to me. bring back album tiles and i'll come back, but right now it's still the same awful card layout. switching to apple music for good.
i'm still on the old build so the price increase doesn't touch me yet. if they force the new layout on me i'm cancelling the day it happens, no question. i just want to listen to music.

eleven bucks for the same service and still no lossless, while Spotify wants double for hifi. tidal already does hifi for less. i'll keep spotify for connect and discovery but i'm getting really tired of this.

the price is whatever, but the home screen looks like TikTok and it's absolute garbage. if they don't revert the redesign i'm cancelling my membership and going to apple music. i've been on this since 2015 and it's getting ruined.
worth every penny at $11. no ads, offline downloads, and unlimited skips every single day. i don't love how free users get treated but premium is still the best subscription i pay for.

not a big deal for me, radio and discover weekly are still the best in the app. i just wish they'd bring back album radio before they charge more. feature-wise it's still the most complete one i've tried.
premium is supposed to be for ad-free music and i still get podcast ads. now they raise the price too. gotta make money somehow i guess, but paying more to get shoved more podcasts is dumb.

they're raising the subscription and artists still get fractions of a cent per stream. i already moved to apple music over this and this just confirms it. spotify cares about the subscription, not the artists.
320 is still fine for me on airpods and in the car, so i'm not really losing anything. but another price rise with still no lossless is hard to justify when tidal and apple already have it.
great, price up again and my liked hearts are still missing from album pages. i'd unsubscribe again if they don't bring them back. apple music is still sitting there tempting me.
i use the duo plan so $11 each is still pretty fair for shared playlists, connect and no ads. i'm not thrilled but it's still worth it for me. i'd be more annoyed if the app got worse.
price hike is whatever honestly, my problem is the app keeps breaking after updates. downloads still fail offline on my phone and i already rolled back. bugs first, then talk to me about more money.
music is absurdly cheap for what you get, so the price itself is fine. but artists are getting almost nothing per stream and spotify is raising prices without fixing that. that's the real problem.
i'm ready to leave if the home screen stays crowded with podcasts and the navigation stays this bad. now they want more money on top of that. just give me my music first.
eh, the price bump is fine. premium is still cheaper than apple for the library and the algorithm is still my main discovery tool. the repetitive recs and hidden discover weekly are a separate issue.

still the best value i pay for. ad-free, skips, downloads and casting are worth it, and the free tier is too restricted to be useful. a dollar more is fine by me as long as the free tier stays this bad.
family plan is still pretty cheap per person, so i'm fine with the increase. as long as my wife and i stay on the duo plan and nothing gets forced on us, it works great for us.
apple music is about the same price now and has lossless and spatial audio. spotify raising again with no hifi is a hard sell. i switched back to spotify for connect but i'm looking at apple again.

i already cancelled and the renewal pop up still shows up every time i open the app. the price doesn't matter to me, it's the pop up that's driving me nuts. tried clearing cache and reinstalling and it's still there.

more money for a shuffle that still isn't random? the price isn't really the problem, it's that i can't get a true random shuffle. i pay for spotify so i don't get random songs, and now they want more for it.

already cancelled premium over the enhance feature so this price hike doesn't change much for me. i'm on free now and only using helper apps. they keep changing things and charging more without fixing the stuff i actually use.
